name: EPIC 228715494
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 14.7 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,431 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.96 solar masses and 14.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,303 K at its surface.
